doc.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe mentions Turré's fan club in Oneida, and they wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well that sounds like a nice coda, place to wrap up. And I just — this is interesting — five minutes before we started this interview I got a call from a local high school teacher asking me if I would do one of those adjudicating gigs you know for the high school jazz band. And this teacher happened to be a trombone player. And I said, “Guess who I’m interviewing in a few minutes?” And I told him, he goes, “Oh, oh he came to our festival in Oneida years ago and everybody loved him.”
Oh I remember that, it’s upstate New York.
Yeah well I just wanted you to know that you have a fan club up here.
That’s nice to know. Yeah, I remember that.
Well good, I enjoyed this so much, I hope you keep getting boing moments.
All right, I’m going to pause this and then we’ll say our good-byes. Thank you very much.
